description:
damage::IsotropicHardening and isotropic::IsotropicHardening are distinct types written by different agents. The isotropic one is the VMIS_ISOT_*/VISC_ISOT_* curve driving the von Mises radial return; the damage one is the curve set used by Rousselier and GTN. Both names are defensible in their own module, so neither was renamed and damage's is left out of the aster re-export block. Consolidating them into one curve type is a design decision, not a mechanical rename. Also worth folding in: damage::equivalent_stress overlaps semantically with viscoplastic::von_mises_of_deviator (one takes full stress, one the deviator), and scale_tensor plus the deviator/mean reassembly are duplicated across viscoplastic.rs and metallurgy.rs.

description: Bring the OpenFOAM boundary-condition set into outram-foam. Current outram-foam-basic-lib BoundaryCondition<T> enum (fields/boundary/bc.rs) has only FixedValue, FixedField, ZeroGradient, Symmetry, Empty, Calculated. Because all BCs share ONE central enum consumed by the FV operators, additions cannot be parallelised across agents (shared enum + exhaustive operator match sites) — so this is run as a SEQUENCE of focused agents, not a racing fleet. Cyclic (periodic) topology is tracked separately as op-6w0.4. Waves: (1) patch-field value/gradient family; (2) cyclic [op-6w0.4]; (3) cyclicAMI; (4) solver-layer flow BCs (different layer, parallel-able).
title: outram-foam: OpenFOAM boundary-condition coverage
